claims.claim: WithAudioMonitor(AudioMonitorOptions) validates Mode and Rate and returns an error for values outside auto/on/off and 16000/24000/48000; Rate 0 means 24000
Mode auto monitors when stdout is a terminal; on always; off never; unset means auto
Conversation.AudioMonitor returns a receive channel of AudioMonitorFrame, nil when monitoring is off
AudioMonitorFrame fields Direction, Samples (mono PCM16, receiver-owned copy), SampleRate, Level, Timestamp
Direction input is the user's audio before the provider, output is the agent's audio; taps sit before the provider stage and after the provider stage
Only PCM16 audio produces frames; chunks are resampled to Rate when the source rate differs
Level is RMS from 0 to 1 and set only when LevelMeter is true
LocalSink and SSEPlayback are hints for the host; the SDK has no audio device and runs no HTTP server
Channel buffer holds 256 frames; a frame that finds it full is dropped
